phase_1_init.send_file_behavior: cmd_high_capacity_send_file (0xabc4) frees any prior *0x46bd0, creates DmmMgr(CheckUnitType(2*(size-4))), stores at *0x46bd0, returns 0x10 -> packet_set_process_req_raw_data (msg[0]=2) -> ReceiveOsalMessage maps/DMAs inline payload into DMM and sets next phase = 4
phase_1_init.get_file_behavior: cmd_high_capacity_get_file (0xb0dc) frees any prior *0x46bd0, creates DmmMgr(CheckUnitType(size-4)), stores at *0x46bd0, returns 0x10 -> packet_set_process_req_raw_data (msg[0]=2) -> ReceiveOsalMessage copies 3-byte inner request into DMM and sets next phase = 4

phase_4_execute.send_file_behavior: Dispatches command 6..16 (15=adj_cmd_set_file_path, 16=adj_cmd_set_file2), writes 4-byte business status at [msg+0x1c], frees DMM buffer and destroys *0x46bd0 (0xac68..0xac88), returns 0 -> packet_set_process_end (msg[0]=8, size=4) -> ReceiveOsalMessage sets phase=0x10 (or 0 if no out-of-line DMM) and returns 4-byte status buffer
phase_4_execute.get_file_behavior: Dispatches command 8..17 (17=adj_cmd_get_file2), allocates DMM for response (4-byte status + payload), returns 0x11 -> packet_set_process_res_raw_data (msg[0]=8, dmm_addr, total_size) -> ReceiveOsalMessage DMAs/copies response from DMM into host reply buffer and sets next phase = 0x10

phase_16_cleanup.behavior: When phase==0x10 (after get_file Phase 4), sends msg[0]=0x10 to libJiritsu -> cmd_high_capacity_get_file (0xb214) calls dmm_free(), destroys *0x46bd0, zeroes *0x46bd0, returns 0x12 -> packet_set_fin_del_data (msg[0]=0x20), then FreeOsalMsg and Inconcurrent::resource_t::unlock()

condition_1_bounded_native_control_sessi.evidence: Stage 285 (fx3-702-service-access-communication-20261101-05) completed MSC->SERVICE->read0(12B+12B+88B)->STOP->same-port MSC return->0da1:9 release->COMPLETE with user screen confirmation.

condition_2_exclusive_state_ownership_or.evidence: Inconcurrent::resource_t::lock (0xdd00..0xdd78) + sequential single-client USB requests prevent USB worker interleaving, and DMM lifecycle (Phase 1 -> Phase 4 -> Phase 16) is self-contained per command. Furthermore, operation 0xFF provides a pure RAM cache-slot read/write path without sys_mount, whereas operation 0 (including /tmp/jiritsu/libJit.so dlopen) calls sys_mount("/dev/nflasha6", "/tmp/jiritsu").

condition_3_precise_side_effect_contract.evidence: SERVICE session exit and automatic MSC return (when camera USB mode is fixed to Mass Storage) are proven on hardware in Stage 285. Any future candidate that uses operation 0 (sys_mount) or dlopen (/tmp/jiritsu/libJit.so) must explicitly account for /tmp/jbusy and /tmp/jiritsu mount behavior rather than claiming zero-side-effect read-only operation.
